events.title: Victorian Christmas Tours
events.description: Glass House specialty tour on Victorian holiday traditions, then carols on the way to the Boone House with nutcracker nibbles and mulled apple cider. Tours start every 30 minutes from 10 a.m. to noon; registration required. $12 residents, $15 non-residents.

events.title: Santa Meet & Greet at Blackhawk Museum
events.price: Free photo with Santa, included with museum admission
events.description: Meet Santa inside the museum and take a free photo, then explore the galleries.

events.title: Makers Market Outdoor Market
events.description: Free open-air market of local makers, handy for last-minute holiday gifts.

events.title: Visits with Santa in the Square
events.venue: Alexander Square, City Center Bishop Ranch
events.description: Visit Santa in front of the big decorated Christmas tree in Alexander Square for a festive photo opportunity and a sweet holiday treat (12-4 p.m. each day).

events.title: Golden Follies Holiday Performance at the Dublin Senior Center
events.description: Las Vegas-style holiday revue by the Golden Follies senior performers, with high-energy dance routines and costumes. Tickets online or at the Senior Center front desk.

events.title: California Symphony: Holiday Traditions (Sat)
events.description: Matinee of the California Symphony's holiday program: brass, percussion and organ in familiar carols and selections from Bach's Christmas Oratorio, led by Donato Cabrera. General admission seating.

events.title: Hōkū & Mistletoe: A Polynesian Style Holiday
events.venue: Dougherty Valley Performing Arts Center, 10550 Albion Rd
events.description: Holiday hula and 'ori Tahiti show by Nā Hula 'o Moku'āina Kūhai Hālau and Motu'āina Pupu 'Ori, billed as the East Bay's longest-running Polynesian holiday show.

events.title: Phil of Genesis - A Musical Tribute to Phil Collins & Genesis
events.description: Tribute show recreating the songs of Phil Collins and Genesis, from ballads to chart-topping anthems.

events.title: The Best Intentions: Motown Christmas (Sat)
events.description: Holiday Motown and old-school R&B show by the vocal group The Best Intentions; second night of a two-night run that usually sells out.

events.title: Christmas with the Count Basie Orchestra
events.description: The Count Basie Orchestra, led by Scotty Barnhart, swings through seasonal standards. Dec 19 at 7:30 p.m. and Dec 20 at 1 p.m.; $75-$170.

events.title: Mochitsuki Workshops at JCCCNC
events.source: Japanese Cultural and Community Center of Northern California
events.description: Learn how rice is pounded into mochi for Japanese New Year and take home up to 2 lbs of fresh mochi; half-hour sign-up shifts, $20 members / $25 non-members.

events.title: Geeta Jayanti Recitation at ISKCON Tri-Central Valley
events.venue: ISKCON Tri-Central Valley (Yogapeeth Center), 6711 Sierra Ct Suite B
events.description: Gita Jayanti / Mokshada Ekadashi observance with an ISV Bhagavad-gita recitation session at the Dublin Yogapeeth Center. Exact session time not posted; confirm with the temple (925-230-8190).

events.title: San Francisco Boys Chorus: Gloria! A Winter Celebration
events.description: The chorus's main holiday concert: every chorus level sings together with the San Francisco Academy Orchestra.

events.title: San Ramon Symphonic Band: Holiday Festival Concert
events.description: Holiday classics from the San Ramon Symphonic Band. Adults $14.92+fees; children 12 and under free. Advance tickets recommended.

events.title: A Chanticleer Christmas
events.description: The Grammy-winning men's vocal ensemble's candlelit holiday program of carols and chant, its San Francisco stop on the Bay Area tour.

events.title: An Evening with Peter Billingsley and A Christmas Story
events.description: Screening of A Christmas Story followed by a conversation and audience Q&A with Peter Billingsley, who played Ralphie.

events.title: Combo Tezeta: Cumbia Christmas
events.venue: SFJAZZ Center, 201 Franklin St (Joe Henderson Lab)
events.description: East Bay seven-piece Combo Tezeta plays a holiday set of instrumental cumbias, chichas and musica tropical. Sets at 7 and 8:30 p.m.; pay-what-you-wish general admission.

events.title: Campana Sobre Campana: Christmas in Mexico
events.description: Mariachi Garibaldi de Jaime Cuéllar and Ballet Folklórico del Río Grande celebrate Posadas, the Reyes Magos and Mexican holiday traditions.

events.title: Holidays with the Tommy Dorsey Orchestra
events.venue: Davies Symphony Hall, 201 Van Ness Ave
events.description: The Tommy Dorsey Orchestra, led by Jeff Bush with vocalist Hayden Grove, swings through holiday favorites (the Symphony does not perform).

events.title: Maurice MOBETTA Brown Holiday Spectacular
events.description: Trumpeter Maurice "Mobetta" Brown brings his jazz, funk and hip-hop holiday jam to SFJAZZ, with a dance floor option; $45-$85.

events.title: The Grand Kyiv Ballet: The Nutcracker - Symphony of Lights
events.venue: Palace of Fine Arts Theatre, 3301 Lyon St
events.description: Tchaikovsky's Nutcracker reimagined with glowing costumes and light design by the touring Grand Kyiv Ballet. Doors 6 p.m.

events.title: Holly Jolly Pops with the SF Symphony
events.venue: Davies Symphony Hall, 201 Van Ness Ave
events.description: Orchestra and Chorus holiday pops with vocalists Ashley Brown and Christian Dante White, plus a visit from Santa. Under-18 tickets half off.

events.title: Marcus Shelby New Orchestra: Duke Ellington's Nutcracker Suite feat. Tiffany Austin
events.description: Bassist Marcus Shelby's big band plays Ellington and Strayhorn's 1960 jazz Nutcracker Suite with vocalist Tiffany Austin, plus holiday music and spirituals.

events.title: Mochi Pounding (Omochitsuki)
events.description: Ring in the Japanese New Year with a mochi-pounding demonstration, a turn at the wooden mallet and fresh mochi tastings. Sessions listed at 11 a.m. and 2 p.m.; included with general admission.

events.title: Pacific Chamber Orchestra: Dreams & Magic
events.description: Maestro Lawrence Kohl and the orchestra play Disney favorites from Beauty and the Beast, The Little Mermaid and more, with Livermore's Nicole King, tenor Ken Christopher and the PCO Chorus.

events.title: Rafiki Kwanzaa Celebration
events.venue: Rafiki Coalition for Health and Wellness, 601 Cesar Chavez St
events.source: Rafiki Coalition for Health and Wellness
events.description: Learn the history of Kwanzaa, with music and drumming, African dance and a Kwanzaa feast in the Bayview.

events.title: 41st Annual Japanese New Year Bell-Ringing Ceremony
events.venue: Samsung Hall, Asian Art Museum, 200 Larkin St
events.description: Ring the museum's 16th-century Japanese temple bell 108 times to welcome the new year, with a chant, guided meditation and short Dharma talk. Included with admission; numbered bell-ringing tickets handed out at Samsung Hall.

events.title: New Year's Day Polar Bear Skate
events.venue: Union Square Holiday Ice Rink, 333 Post St
events.source: Safeway Holiday Ice Rink in Union Square
events.description: Start 2027 by skating in your most outrageous swimwear in Union Square; prizes for the best-dressed skaters.

events.title: Mads Tolling & John R. Burr: Ramblin' + Matt Finders & Friends
events.description: Double bill: violinist Mads Tolling and pianist John R. Burr open with a genre-spanning set from Ornette Coleman to Paul McCartney, then Matt Finders and an all-star Bay Area jazz nonet swing through the 1930s-40s Great American Songbook.

events.title: Motown Mania
events.venue: Hofmann Theatre at Lesher Center for the Arts
events.description: High-energy Motown hits tribute concert at the Hofmann Theatre.

events.title: A Night with the Cast of The Sopranos
events.description: On-stage panel with Sopranos cast members Matt Servitto, Jason Cerbone, Dan Grimaldi, Robert Funaro, plus a mystery guest.

events.title: Ronstadt Revolution: A Tribute to Linda Ronstadt
events.venue: Hofmann Theatre at Lesher Center for the Arts
events.description: Tribute to Linda Ronstadt returning to the Lesher Center with award-winning hits and new selections.

events.title: The Carole King Tribute: Home Again
events.description: Deb De Lucca and band perform Carole King's catalog from Tapestry-era hits through her classic songwriting standards.

events.title: Watch What Crappens: In The Mix Tour
events.description: Ben Mandelker and Ronnie Karam of Watch What Crappens bring live Bravo recaps, gossip, and comedy to the Palace of Fine Arts.

events.title: Littles Skate: Skate on the Wild Side with Lindsay Wildlife
events.venue: Walnut Creek on Ice, Civic Park, 1365 Civic Drive
events.source: Walnut Creek Downtown / Walnut Creek on Ice
events.description: Ages 5 and under: Littles Skate morning with Lindsay Wildlife Experience animal ambassadors. $35 adult+child bundle with walker; skate rentals included.

events.title: PYTC: Shrek the Musical KIDS
events.description: Pleasanton Youth Theatre Company presents Shrek the Musical KIDS with multiple performances Jan 16–24, 2027.

events.title: Tri-Valley Theatre Company: Come From Away
events.source: Livermore Valley Arts / Tri-Valley Theatre Company
events.description: Critically acclaimed musical based on the true story of Gander, Newfoundland welcoming 7,000 stranded travelers on 9/11. Runs Jan 16–24, 2027.

events.title: Jesse Cook: Forever Live Tour
events.description: Spanish guitar master Jesse Cook brings rumba flamenco and world music on the Forever Live Tour.

events.title: SFJAZZ Collective: Wayne Shorter's Native Dancer
events.description: SFJAZZ's all-star resident ensemble performs music from Wayne Shorter's Native Dancer plus original compositions inspired by the album.

events.title: Anand Varma: Exploring Nature's Hidden Worlds
events.source: Livermore Valley Arts / Rae Dorough Speaker Series
events.description: Biologist-photographer Anand Varma reveals hidden natural behaviors through cutting-edge photography, from honeybees to hummingbirds.

events.title: Five For Fighting with Strings
events.description: John Ondrasik of Five for Fighting reimagines hits like Superman and 100 Years in a concert with strings.

events.title: Jobim & Getz Centennial Celebration with Trio Da Paz, Harry Allen & Maucha Adnet
events.description: Trio da Paz celebrates the Jobim and Stan Getz centennials with Harry Allen and Maucha Adnet in a bossa nova and cool jazz program.

events.title: Revisiting Creedence
events.description: CCR tribute band whose members were selected by original Creedence Clearwater Revival musicians to carry on the catalog.

events.title: Kings Return
events.description: Grammy-nominated a cappella quartet blending gospel, jazz, R&B, and classical music.

events.title: Be Like Blippi Tour
events.description: Interactive family show with Blippi and Meekah featuring music, laughter, and fan-favorite songs.

events.title: Free First Sunday at the Asian Art Museum
events.description: Free general admission on the first Sunday of the month, with hands-on artmaking, storytelling, gallery activities and tours; timed-ticket reservation recommended.

events.title: Free First Sunday at the Asian Art Museum
events.description: Free general admission on the first Sunday of the month, with hands-on artmaking, storytelling, gallery activities and tours; timed-ticket reservation recommended.

events.title: Dance-Along Nutcracker: A Dance-Along Toy Story
events.venue: Yerba Buena Center for the Arts – Forum, 701 Mission St
events.description: The 75-piece SF Pride Band's 40-plus-year holiday tradition: an original comic musical built around Tchaikovsky's score plus Toy Story and Barbie tunes, with cues for the audience to get up and dance (tutus encouraged). Shows Dec 19 at 3 & 7 p.m. and Dec 20 at 11 a.m. & 3 p.m.; about 2 hours, all ages.

events.title: 24th Annual Parol Lantern Festival
events.venue: Yerba Buena Center for the Arts & Yerba Buena Gardens, 701 Mission St
events.description: Free Filipino holiday festival centered on the star-shaped parol lantern: Taste of Christmas food samples (3-5 p.m.), a lantern parade through Yerba Buena Gardens (5-7 p.m.), the Tala Awards for decorated parols, a drag showcase at 7 p.m. and a closing dance party.

events.title: Morning Ragas: Arjun Ravi Shankar with Gaurav Kale (tabla)
events.venue: Bird & Beckett Books & Records, 653 Chenery St
events.description: A Sunday-morning program of Hindustani ragas meant for the early hours, sung by Bay Area vocalist Arjun Ravi Shankar with tabla by Gaurav Kale, in a Glen Park bookshop. No reservations needed.

events.title: Photosynthesis: Conservatory of Flowers Light Show
events.venue: Conservatory of Flowers, 100 John F Kennedy Dr, Golden Gate Park
events.description: Free nightly winter light show projected onto the Victorian glasshouse, set to original music. Starts about 30 minutes after sunset and runs roughly half an hour; watch from the front lawn and dress warmly.

events.title: Grow + Make: Botanical Holiday Cards & Presses
events.venue: Conservatory of Flowers – Orchid Pavilion, Golden Gate Park
events.description: Hands-on morning workshop making holiday cards and art from fresh and dried leaves and flowers; everyone assembles a take-home flower press. All materials included.

events.title: Sound Bath in the Orchid Pavilion (Dec 27)
events.venue: Conservatory of Flowers, 100 John F Kennedy Dr, Golden Gate Park
events.description: An hour-long meditative sound bath by Blue Muse & the Celestial Voice among the Conservatory's orchids, a calm way to wind down between the holidays.

events.title: Candlelight Tour of Fort Point (Nov 14)
events.venue: Fort Point National Historic Site, 201 Marine Dr
events.description: Ranger-led after-hours tour of the Civil War-era fort by candlelight beneath the Golden Gate Bridge, including a climb to the roof. Tours at 6:30 and 7 p.m.; $20 adults, $12 ages 10-17, recommended 12+. Reserve and arrive 15 minutes early.

events.title: Candlelight Tour of Fort Point (Nov 21)
events.venue: Fort Point National Historic Site, 201 Marine Dr
events.description: Ranger-led after-hours tour of the Civil War-era fort by candlelight beneath the Golden Gate Bridge, including a climb to the roof. Tours at 6:30 and 7 p.m.; $20 adults, $12 ages 10-17, recommended 12+. Reserve and arrive 15 minutes early.

events.title: Presidio Chapel Concert: RusLan Biryukov Cello Recital
events.description: Free midday cello recital in the historic Presidio Chapel; RSVP requested for in-person seats, donations welcome.

events.title: Veterans Day Interfaith Service at the Presidio Chapel
events.description: A free interfaith Veterans Day service, with a keynote from Michael Blecker, executive director emeritus of Swords to Plowshares. RSVP requested.

events.title: Christmas Eve Carols & Mass at the Presidio Chapel
events.description: Open-to-all Christmas Eve in the Presidio's hilltop chapel: carols at 7 p.m. followed by Mass at 7:30 p.m.

events.title: Holiday Artisan Fair at the de Young
events.venue: de Young Museum – Wilsey Court, Golden Gate Park
events.source: Fine Arts Museums of San Francisco
events.description: Free two-day holiday market of local makers in the de Young's Wilsey Court, Dec 4-5, 9:30 a.m.-5:15 p.m.

events.title: Sip & Sketch at the Asian Art Museum
events.venue: Asian Art Museum – Loggia, 200 Larkin St
events.description: Drop-in afternoon drawing session in the museum's loggia with art supplies, tea and tastings provided; included with general admission.

events.title: 40th Annual Teddy Bear Tea
events.venue: The Gardens at Heather Farm, 1540 Marchbanks Dr
events.description: A dress-up holiday tea party for young kids (best for ages 3-8) and their teddy bears, with tea sandwiches, juice or decaf tea, a dessert buffet and a festive photo spot. Seatings at 10:30 a.m. and 2:30 p.m. each day; $65 adults, $50 children. Usually sells out fast.

events.title: Ho Ho Holiday Carnival
events.venue: Sycamore Grove Park (Arroyo Rd lot), 5049 Arroyo Rd
events.source: Livermore Area Recreation and Park District
events.description: Outdoor evening carnival with midway games, holiday crafts and treats hosted by park rangers and Santa's helpers. Ages 3+, registration required ($15 residents/$17 non-residents); kids must come with a registered adult.

events.title: LYC Turkey Trot 5K
events.source: Livermore Area Recreation and Park District
events.description: Free, untimed day-before-Thanksgiving fun run with the Livermore Youth Council, starting 8 a.m. from the equestrian lot. Registration required; bring canned food for Open Heart Kitchen.

events.title: Ranger Program: Natural Wreath Making
events.source: Livermore Area Recreation and Park District
events.description: Free outdoor ranger program to build your own holiday wreath from trimmings gathered in the park. All ages; register ahead, canceled for rain or high winds.

events.title: Noon Year's Eve Celebration
events.venue: Robert Livermore Community Center, 4444 East Ave
events.source: Livermore Area Recreation and Park District
events.description: Kid-friendly New Year's countdown at midday, with games, crafts, dancing, light refreshments and a balloon drop at noon. Everyone 3+ registers ($15); no refunds.

events.title: Gita 101: Wisdom for Everyday Life
events.venue: ISKCON Tri-Central Valley, 6711 Sierra Ct Suite B
events.description: A three-hour beginner workshop introducing the Bhagavad Gita and how its ideas apply to daily life, held the week before Gita Jayanti. Registration required.
